answer_1.quote: To accomplish this, we will discuss the challenges of using LLMs for summarisation ( §2). Afterwards, we will explain our system implementation for generating Hotel Highlights ( §3).
answer_1.outputs: Hotel Highlights are concise, one to two sentences summarising an accommodation's unique selling points, derived from traveller reviews and descriptions.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation experiment to better understand the quality of the generated highlights.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were shown a hotel description and a highlight, and asked to specify whether there were any divergences between the two. They could choose if there was a hallucination, a contradiction, both, or no divergence. Then they rated each highlight for clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality on a 7-point Likert scale.
